caption: A sample's path through Prometheus: discovery and relabeling choose the targets, the scrape loop pulls, and the TSDB writes to the WAL and the in-memory head before cutting two-hour blocks to disk.
alt: Service discovery produces candidate targets with __meta labels. Relabel configs keep or drop targets and set final labels. The scrape loop pulls metrics from each target; metric relabel configs filter samples. Samples are appended to the write-ahead log on disk and to the in-memory head block. About every two hours the head is cut into an immutable block on disk, and compaction merges blocks. The rule engine and PromQL read from the head and blocks; firing alerts go to Alertmanager; remote write streams samples from the WAL to long-term storage.
